extract_batch over URI inputs

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Xberg\Xberg;
use Xberg\ExtractInput;
use Xberg\ExtractionConfig;
$result = Xberg::extractBatch([ExtractInput::from_json('{"kind":"uri","uri":"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf"}'), ExtractInput::from_json('{"kind":"uri","uri":"https://example.com/text/fake_text.txt"}')], \Xberg\ExtractionConfig::from_json('{}'));
foreach ($result->getResults() as $result) {
    echo $result->getContent(), PHP_EOL;
}
```
